g.title: hooks
g.text: Hook retrieval and delivery ownership | refactor candidate

g.title: tool
g.text: Claude: deliver earlier pending, even on successful event;
then failure -> detached work file + worker
Codex: failure enqueues current job; legacy entry retained
Cursor: current event search and delivery

g.title: stop
g.text: recursion guard; structural signals if not Jev

g.title: dedupe
g.text: compose shared texts; host adapter serializes

g.title: discard
g.text: discard old session pending before output
retain global pending; this is separate from delivery ack

g.title: legacy
g.text: open DB -> structural retrieval -> OS filter
markHit OR opt-in miss log -> close DB

g.title: jev
g.text: observation saved as pending / suppressed / none

g.title: leak
g.text: search/filter/diagnostic failure or early return closes DB
close/diagnostic throw propagates to caller / CLI error boundary

g.title: tool->dedupe
g.text: Claude: earlier pending before new worker

g.title: jevskip
g.text: tool and stop suppress legacy search

g.title: commit
g.text: Nonempty output success OR deduped texts empty
sequential writes, not atomic; exception may partly commit

g.title: dedupe->commit
g.text: empty after dedupe: no stdout needed
